EtherDelta is a decentralized exchange built on the Ethereum blockchain. EtherDelta enables trading of ERC-20 tokens through an order book. EtherDelta operates through smart contracts rather than a central intermediary.

Terra is a blockchain platform built for algorithmic stablecoins. Terra issues stablecoins such as TerraUSD whose price is supported by its native token LUNA. Terra uses a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism.

Avalanche (AVAX) is a public smart contract platform. Avalanche uses a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism. Avalanche has a native token called AVAX. Avalanche is organized into multiple blockchains that run in parallel.

Salt is a lending platform built on the Ethereum blockchain. Salt allows users to borrow against crypto assets using smart contracts. Salt has a native token called SALT.

USD Coin is a fiat-collateralized stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. USD Coin is issued by Circle. USD Coin is an ERC-20 token that runs on the Ethereum blockchain.
